description: Live smoke after a backend restart (İş Emri 2026-10-15A2L). Nine questions, one attempt each; a row passes only when HTTP is 200 AND every expectation holds (Ortak Not 15.10 §5 ilke 5: a successful request is not a correct answer). Expected values are written the F-8 way (thousands dot, decimal comma) and must appear in the answer exactly so; an English thousands spelling anywhere in the answer fails the row. Scripts: scripts/smoke_live.py, schema + evaluator tests: backend/tests/test_smoke_live.py.
